summary: Answer coding-agent permission prompts from your Kobo. Needs your computer.
release_notes: Headings are a step smaller, small print such as hints and dates a step larger, and there is more room under the top bar.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.

Pair this computer with the reader. It writes the pairing for Sidekick, Deck and Paperterm onto the reader, so there is nothing to type there. The first time, close Cobalt and open it again afterwards.
Let Claude Code ask through Sidekick. Use codex instead of claude for Codex.
Start the helper and leave it running, then open Sidekick on the reader.
